title: Applications for Payment
description: Project billing through schedules of values, cumulative applications, change orders, and retainage.

errors.load: Could not load applications for payment
errors.notFound: The project or record was not found. It may be outside your access — reload and retry.
errors.notApplicationsBilling: This project does not use applications for payment. Activate an applications-for-payment project type and assign it to the project.
errors.featureOff: The Projects feature is off. Turn it on in Company Settings → Features before billing.
errors.incomeAccountNotFound: The income account was not found. Choose another account and retry.
errors.sovDescriptionValueRequired: Enter a description and a positive scheduled value.
errors.retainageRange: Retainage percent must be between 0 and 100.
errors.sortOrderWhole: Sort order must be a whole number.
errors.lockedAfterBilling: Billing has begun — change the contract value through an approved change order.
errors.sovLineNotFound: The schedule line was not found. Reload and retry.
errors.controlledLineDelete: A controlled schedule line cannot be deleted. Use a reversing change order.
errors.immutableLine: This schedule line is immutable once used. Use a change order.
errors.changeOrderNumberAmountRequired: Enter a change-order number and a non-zero amount.
errors.deductiveNeedsLine: A deductive change order must name the schedule line it reduces.
errors.duplicateChangeOrderNumber: A change order with this number already exists for this project. Use another number.
errors.targetLineOutsideProject: The target schedule line does not belong to this project.
errors.changeOrderNotFound: The change order was not found or is no longer a draft. Reload and retry.
errors.selfApproval: The preparer cannot approve their own change order. Ask another approver.
errors.changeOrderOutOfRange: The change-order amount does not fit the ledger. Enter a smaller amount.
errors.contractBelowZero: Approving this change order would drive the contract value below zero.
errors.applicationInProgress: Complete or void the current application before approving a change order.
errors.targetLineGone: The target schedule line no longer exists. Reload and retry.
errors.unallocatedAdditive: An unallocated change order must be additive (positive).
errors.onlyDraftVoid: Only a draft change order can be voided.
